title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 2: David is anointed king in Hebron, Ishbosheth reigns over Israel, and Abner kills Asahel.

questions.text: To which city did Yahweh tell David to go up?
questions.explanation: David asked where he should go up, and Yahweh said, "To Hebron."

questions.text: What did the men of Judah do at Hebron?
questions.explanation: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah.

answers.text: They made a treaty with the Philistines
They brought Saul's body to David
They anointed David king over the house of Judah
They built an altar to Yahweh

questions.text: Whom did Abner the son of Ner make king?
questions.explanation: Abner took Ishbosheth the son of Saul to Mahanaim and made him king over all Israel.

questions.text: How old was Ishbosheth when he began to reign over Israel?
questions.explanation: Ishbosheth, Saul's son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years.

questions.text: How long was David king in Hebron over the house of Judah?
questions.explanation: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

questions.text: Where did Joab and David's servants meet Abner and his men?
questions.explanation: Joab and David's servants met them by the pool of Gibeon and sat down on either side of the pool.

questions.text: To what was Asahel's speed compared?
questions.explanation: Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
Asahel refused to turn away, so Abner struck him in the body with the back end of the spear, and he died there.

answers.text: With a stone from a sling
With an arrow from his bow
With the back end of his spear

questions.text: What did Joab do to stop the fighting?
questions.explanation: Joab blew the trumpet, and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more.

answers.text: He sent a messenger to Abner

questions.explanation: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem.

answers.text: In his father's tomb in Bethlehem
